neighbours.label: 'can' after a subject when the sentence states a drawback or risk ('they can be expensive', 'and can have a waiting list')
fire: Imported cheeses taste great, but they can be hard to find in small towns.
Public hospitals are cheap and can have very long waiting times.
Old laptops are fine for email, but they can overheat during games.
Rental scooters are handy, yet they can break down without warning.
Hand-made shoes last for years, though they can cost a fortune.
Mountain roads are scenic and can be dangerous in winter.
Rescue dogs make loyal pets, but they can need a lot of training.
Cheap flights save money, though they can involve long layovers.
